story.iWant: I want to assign uploaded documents and generated content to specific classes and sections,
story.soThat: So that I can easily find and access my study materials.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: **Given** I have uploaded documents and created classes/sections **When** I assign a document or generated content to a class/section **Then** it appears within that class/section. **And** I can view all documents and generated content organized by class and section. **And** when a document is moved, all its associated generated content (summaries, quizzes) shall automatically move with it. **And** when viewing a class/section, generated content (summaries, quizzes) is clearly linked to and displayed alongside its source document.

artifact.title: AI Study Buddy - High-Level Architecture
artifact.snippet: The database will be implemented in Supabase (PostgreSQL). The schema is designed to support a hierarchical content organization and the relationships between `study_materials`, `generated_content`, `classes`, and `class_sections` tables.

artifact.title: AI Study Buddy - High-Level Architecture
artifact.snippet: Row Level Security (RLS) will be enabled on all user data tables in Supabase to ensure strict data isolation. Relevant for content assignment and viewing.

interface.name: Assign Generated Content to Class/Section API

constraint.description: Row Level Security (RLS) must be enabled on `study_materials`, `generated_content`, `classes`, and `class_sections` tables to ensure strict data isolation and prevent unauthorized access to content.

Database relationships between `study_materials`, `generated_content`, `classes`, and `class_sections` must be correctly implemented to support content assignment and movement. Cascading updates should ensure associated generated content moves with the source document.
Efficient queries are required to retrieve all documents and generated content organized by class and section, especially for users with large amounts of study materials.

tests.standards: The project utilizes Jest with `jest-environment-jsdom` and React Testing Library for comprehensive unit and integration testing. A strict "no-flaky-tests" policy is enforced to maintain test reliability. Critical security measures, such as Row Level Security (RLS) policies, are also verified through automated tests.

ideas.idea: Verify that when a document or generated content is assigned to a class/section, it appears within that class/section.
Verify that all documents and generated content can be viewed when organized by class and section.
Verify that when a document is moved, all its associated generated content (summaries, quizzes) automatically move with it.
Verify that when viewing a class/section, generated content (summaries, quizzes) is clearly linked to and displayed alongside its source document.
Verify that only the authenticated user can assign and view their own content (RLS enforcement).
